part_functions.name: brew coffee
part_functions.function: Supports a drip-brewing mechanism and directs brewed liquid into a removable carafe.

part_functions.name: contain and present carafe
part_functions.function: Provides a front bay, warming-platform region, and clearance for a handled beverage carafe.

part_functions.function: Routes mains power through an external flexible cord and two-pin plug.

part_functions.name: protect internal components
part_functions.function: The rounded enclosure shields brewing, heating, and electrical components while providing a stable appliance body.

section_functions.name: protect and support
section_functions.function: Forms the primary load-bearing appliance shell and defines the rounded external body, top reservoir region, and front opening interfaces.

feature_functions.name: enclose internals
feature_functions.function: Large planar, cylindrical, and spline walls create a rigid rounded enclosure with localized openings and bearing interfaces.

section_functions.function: Nested cylindrical and rectangular components form the rear reservoir, brew chamber, conduit, and outlet transition.

feature_functions.function: A rectangular insert with a circular opening partitions the rear housing and supports the cylindrical brew components.

feature_functions.name: space and seal
feature_functions.function: Thin concentric annulus separates nested cylindrical reservoir or brew-chamber components.

feature_functions.function: Concentric cylindrical walls provide a chamber with localized notches and outlet transitions.

feature_functions.function: Nested toroidal and cylindrical surfaces provide a rounded, coaxial outlet interface.

section_functions.function: Thin front plates, repeated ribs, openings, and a small central tab create a decorative or ventilating fascia over the housing front.

feature_functions.name: cover front interface

feature_functions.name: vent and stiffen
feature_functions.function: A thin curved insert with repeated rectangular ribs creates ventilation slots and locally stiffens the front panel.

section_functions.function: A removable cylindrical carafe, handle interface, and central pedestal occupy the front bay and align beneath the brew outlet.

feature_functions.function: A thick planar-and-cylindrical loop projects from the carafe to permit lifting and pouring.

section_functions.name: support appliance
section_functions.function: Two symmetric rounded rectangular feet or mounting blocks stabilize the housing and provide compliant contact geometry.

feature_functions.name: carry vertical load
feature_functions.function: Rounded rectangular block distributes appliance weight to the supporting surface.

feature_functions.function: Mirror-symmetric rounded rectangular block shares appliance weight and resists rocking.

section_functions.name: support or carry housing
section_functions.function: A broad U-shaped external member wraps around the rounded body and engages two coaxial side pivots.

feature_functions.name: retain and pivot
feature_functions.function: The curved strap embraces the housing while cylindrical ends rotate on symmetric side bosses, allowing carrying or angular support.

section_functions.name: transmit mains electricity
section_functions.function: A flexible, curved two-conductor lead connects the appliance body to the detachable-looking molded plug.

feature_functions.name: route power flexibly
feature_functions.function: Swept spline surfaces form a slender insulated cable able to bend without imposing large loads on the housing.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Upper transition of inner conductor jacket.
Lower transition of inner conductor jacket.

section_functions.name: connect to wall outlet
section_functions.function: A molded plug body with two projecting conductive prongs provides the external electrical interface.

feature_functions.name: electrical connection and insulation
feature_functions.function: The molded body retains and electrically isolates two parallel prongs while transferring pull loads into the cord.
